sources.finding: Textarea default text and current value are distinct; do not universally substitute text content for current value.
currentTarget resets after dispatch; not every await is a dispatch boundary.
DOM click fires synthetic activation; it is not proof of physical reachability.
Browser interaction mechanisms can account for scrolling/obstruction; CDP coordinates are not mandatory.
Example E2E framework with runner/isolation; not a compulsory common dependency.
CLI+skills is recommended by authors for coding agents; local context savings have not been measured.
MCP is an interactive browser interface; its authors distinguish it from CLI workflows.
Chrome diagnostics, including network/console/performance; official support limited to Chrome/Chrome for Testing.
Selenium documents bidirectional automation; consider when compatible with project infrastructure.
